notes.title: Final Update Devlog
notes.notes:
Hi! I'm working on the last big Purplis Sandbox update, and now I'm going to show what is planned to be added to the game.



[h1]steam[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39466761/25718a1630127de535ae6cb0aecfe01435104155.png[/img]

[h1]nighttime[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39466761/788b7b8c1b2d4b08e8d9e584579a7649be280c8b.png[/img]

[h1]gases[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39466761/e64c0200c815a2d61f8ee2677d796abfcc5ae8e8.png[/img]



[h3]Also I'm planning to add the camera zoom, freezing mechanics and a lot more.[/h3]

It's going to be the last major update. After that there would be only small minor fixes.
